source: NASA PCoE Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset

official_page_states: Capacity experiments span distinct current loads, voltage cutoffs, and temperatures.
Some cutoff voltages are below the OEM-recommended 2.7 V.
Dataset-level rated capacity is described as 2 Ah, with general EOL at 1.4 Ah (30% fade).
The MATLAB Capacity field is described as Ah for discharge to 2.7 V.
The intended use emphasizes run-to-failure prognostics and notes differing DOD, rest duration, and intrinsic variability.

local_readme_conflicts.finding: These group READMEs state EOL at 1.6 Ah (20% fade), not the official page's general 1.4 Ah/30% description.
Each describes the Capacity field as Ah to 2.7 V, while cell-specific experimental cutoffs range from 2.0 V to 2.7 V.
Explicitly states that several capacities are very low and their reasons have not been fully analyzed.

provisional_label_audit.current_formula: 100 * measured capacity / median of first 10 positive capacities
provisional_label_audit.specific_anomaly: B0041's very low capacities are retained and flagged; the local README states the reasons have not been fully analyzed.

measured_reference_soh.formula: 100 * measured discharge capacity / justified cell-specific reference capacity
measured_reference_soh.reason: No reviewed NASA documentation designates a cell-specific reference-performance capacity. The first-ten positive median is an undocumented heuristic, and protocols and capacity anomalies are not resolved.

rated_capacity_ratio.name: B0005 discharge capacity as percent of documented rated capacity
rated_capacity_ratio.scope: B0005 only; no generalization to other batteries claimed

scope.eol_discrepancy: The local README states a 1.4 Ah stopping criterion, but the raw sequence contains measurements below it; the cause remains unresolved.
scope.evaluation_interpretation: A chronological holdout from one cell measures only within-B0005 later-cycle prediction under this observed protocol; it is not an independent-cell validation.
scope.test_partition_shift: The final test partition consists entirely of observations below the README's 1.4 Ah EOL threshold; the validation partition crosses that threshold. This observed tail shift limits interpretation of the holdout scores.

definitions_and_units.discharge_ordinal: Count of completed/target discharge position; unitless and known from operation order.
definitions_and_units.elapsed_hours_before_discharge: Elapsed hours from the first pre-discharge operation start to the most recent completed operation start; hours.

prediction_time_features.contract: Features are limited to the next discharge ordinal and the timestamp of the immediately preceding completed operation. The timestamp is strictly earlier than target-discharge start. No target capacity, target discharge trace, future measurements, or target-derived fields enter X.
prediction_time_features.timestamp_availability_limitation: The elapsed-time feature uses the latest completed operation timestamp, not the target discharge timestamp. A deployed system must provide an equivalent prior-operation timestamp.

chronological_split.validation_use: Candidate model selection by validation RMSE.
chronological_split.final_fit: Selected estimator and preprocessing refit on train + validation only; test held out.
chronological_split.preprocessing: Median imputation is inside each sklearn Pipeline and is fit only on that fit's training partition; no feature scaler used for tree models or linear regression.

final_test_metrics.performance_assessment: Not validated for deployment or generalization: the selected model has negative chronological test R2, and all test rows are below the documented EOL threshold. The run demonstrates pipeline execution only.

evaluation.performance_assessment: Not validated for deployment or generalization: the selected model has negative chronological test R2, and all test rows are below the documented EOL threshold. The run demonstrates pipeline execution only.

limitations: The chronological test partition has negative R2.
Every test observation is below the README's 1.4 Ah EOL threshold.
The 44 below-threshold B0005 records are retained; their presence conflicts with the documented stopping rule and is unexplained.
A single-cell chronological holdout does not validate generalization to unseen batteries.

overall_decision: Option C for a deployable/general Battery Health SOH model: no measured-reference target is validated. Option B is supported only as the separately named B0005 rated-capacity research target; its existing experiment does not validate deployment or generalization.
excluded_observations_policy: Only non-finite or non-positive capacity entries are excluded from the current positive-capacity processed CSV; each is listed above with its source operation and reason. Review flags are not exclusions.
scientific_blockers: NASA documentation describes different discharge cut-off voltages, load profiles, and ambient temperatures across battery groups; capacity measurements are not protocol-equivalent.
The README files describe the MATLAB Capacity field as Ah to 2.7 V, while their experiment descriptions specify cut-offs from 2.0 V to 2.7 V for individual batteries.
The README for B0041-B0044 explicitly says very low discharge capacities occur and their reasons have not been fully analyzed.
The current first-10-positive-cycle reference is affected by unresolved low-capacity observations and has no documented healthy reference-performance measurement protocol.
Current aggregate features are measured during the same discharge operation as capacity; a valid prediction-time feature contract has not been established.
The dataset manifest does not explicitly authorize training against a validated SOH target.
